name: slingshot_kick_const
description: slingshot_hit with params.kicker=3: kicker_hit sets kick_strength=param[2] (cs:1B5D), but for ball y >= 200 it overwrites it with the constant 6 (cs:1BD3), so the slingshot kick stays 6 (bumpers, y < 200, use param[2]). Latent in real play (param[2] is 6 in EP2).
